system.description:
In a way, we are magicians. We are alchemists, sorcerers and wizards. We are a very strange bunch. But there is great fun in being a wizard. And great power, too. —Billy Joel, Berklee College of Music Commencement 1993 Wizards are students of the arcane arts who research and develop spells as academic pursuit.

The wizard is a squishy blaster focused on Casting Spells. Stay in safety to Cast your Spells and discover Enemy weaknesses.

  • Action: Cast
  • Move: Backline
  • Key Stat: Reason
  • Complexity: HHHII
  • Training: Arcana, Craft, Mysticism

Trainings at Level 1: the Class's Trainings, plus a number of additional Trainings equal to half your Reason (round up).

features.name: Spellcaster
features.description:
You can Cast Spells using Arcana.

Spells: You learn 4 Spells, and 1 other Spell every 2 Levels hereafter.

Mana: Your Max Mana is equal to (4 × your Level), and your Cast Max for Spells is equal to (2 + your Level).

features.name: Page Master
features.description: You gain the Bookworm Perk (p. 67), and you can spend a Studied die to learn a Spell for the Shift.

features.name: Manifold Mind
features.description:
The number of Spells you can Focus on at the same time increases by 1 now and every 4 Levels hereafter.

Wizard: 2nd, 6th, 10th Level.

features.name: Sculpt Spell
features.description:
You pay 1 less Mana for Delivery upcasting. This discount is increased by 1 every 4 Levels hereafter.

Wizard: 4th, 8th Level.

features.name: Extracurricular
features.description: When you successfully Cast a Spell, you can spend a Studied die to add the effect of another Spell you know to that Casting.

features.name: Archwizard
features.description: You can Cast Spells you do not know, but you cannot spend Mana to upcast them.
